<title>思维小画本</title>
<style>

:root{
  --paper:#FFFCF2; --ink:#2A2523; --ink-soft:#6F665E; --line:#E4DCC9;
  --red:#E8452C; --orange:#F08A24; --yellow:#F5B921; --green:#3FA34D;
  --blue:#2E7DD1; --purple:#7B4BC9; --pink:#E4568E; --teal:#12A5A0;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;padding:0;overscroll-behavior:none;overflow:hidden}
body{
  background:var(--paper);
  background-image:radial-gradient(var(--line) 1.2px,transparent 1.3px);
  background-size:22px 22px;
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:"PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Microsoft YaHei","Heiti SC",sans-serif;
  -webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;touch-action:manipulation;
}
.num{font-family:"Arial Rounded MT Bold","Avenir Next Rounded","Nunito","PingFang SC",sans-serif;font-weight:700}
#app{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;
  padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) env(safe-area-inset-right) env(safe-area-inset-bottom) env(safe-area-inset-left)}
/* ---------- 顶栏 ---------- */
#topbar{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 12px;min-width:0}
.iconbtn{width:46px;height:46px;flex:0 0 auto;border:3px solid var(--ink);background:#fff;border-radius:14px;
  font-size:21px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);cursor:pointe…
.iconbtn:active{transform:translate(3px,3px);box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--ink)}
#barTitle{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;font-size:19px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#starBox{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:19px;padding:5px 12px;border:3px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius:999px;background:#fff;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink)}
#sayBtn{background:var(--yellow)}
#sayBtn.talking{animation:pl 1s infinite}
/* ---------- 屏幕 ---------- */
#screen{flex:1 1 auto;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:0}
.pane{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0 12px 12px;overflow:hidden}
/* ---------- 首页 ---------- */
.hero{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;padding:0 4px 8px}
.hero h1{margin:0;font-size:26px;transform:rotate(-1.2deg)}
.hero p{margin:0;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:14px}
#cards{flex:1 1 auto;display:grid;gap:10px;min-height:0}
.card{border:4px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--ink);cursor:pointer;min-height:0;padding-bottom:12%}
.card:nth-child(odd){transform:rotate(-.8deg)}
.card:nth-child(even){transform:rotate(.8deg)}
.card:active{transform:translate(4px,4px) rotate(0);box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--ink)}
.card .band{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:11%;background:var(--c)}
.card .band i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.35) 0 6px,transparent 6px 14px…
.card .emoji{line-height:1.05;position:relative;z-index:1}
.card .name{font-weight:700;position:relative;z-index:1}
.card .lv{position:absolute;top:6px;right:9px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);z-index:1}
#stickerBar{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:8px 4px 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft);
  min-height:34px;overflow:hidden}
#stickerBar b{font-size:23px;font-weight:400}
/* ---------- 选关 ---------- */
#lvWrap{flex:1 1 auto;display:grid;gap:10px;min-height:0;align-content:center}
.lvcard{border:4px solid var(--ink);border-radius:16px;background:#fff;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink);cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 14px;min-height:0;position:relative}
.lvcard:active{transform:translate(4px,4px);box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--ink)}
.lvcard .no{flex:0 0 auto;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:3px solid var(--ink);display:flex;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;background:var(--c);color:#fff}
.lvcard .tx{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0}
.lvcard .t1{font-size:17px;font-weight:700}
.lvcard .t2{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.lvcard .st{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--orange)}
.lvcard .tag{position:absolute;top:-10px;right:10px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-size:11px;
  padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid var(--ink)}
/* ---------- 关卡外壳 ---------- */
#dots{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;gap:7px;justify-content:center;padding:2px 0 6px}
#dots i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--ink);background:#fff;display:block}
#dots i.on{background:var(--yellow)}
#prompt{flex:0 0 auto;text-align:center;font-weight:700;padding:0 0 6px;line-height:1.25}
#board{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hid…
#targetChip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--yellow);box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);padding:0 10px;margin:0 6px;vertical-align:middle}
/* ---------- 通用块 ---------- */
.tile{border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;line-height:1}
.tile:active{transform:translate(3px,3px);box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--ink)}
.tile.done{background:var(--green);color:#fff;box-shadow:none;transform:none;cursor:default}
.tile.pick{background:var(--yellow)}
.tile.rd{color:var(--red)}
.tile.bl{color:var(--blue)}
.shake{animation:sh .34s}
@keyframes sh{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(-7px)}50%{transform:translateX(7px)}80%{transform:translateX…
.pulse{animation:pl 1s infinite}
@keyframes pl{0%,100%{filter:none}50%{filter:brightness(1.12) drop-shadow(0 0 10px var(--yellow))}}
.pop{animation:pp .35s}
@keyframes pp{0%{transform:scale(.7)}60%{transform:scale(1.12)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.row2{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.col2{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
/* 点子 */
.face{display:grid;width:100%;height:100%;place-content:center;gap:var(--dotgap,3px);overflow:hidden;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,var(--dotsz,8px));grid-template-rows:repeat(3,var(--dotsz,8px))}
.face.wide{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,var(--dotsz,8px));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,var(--dotsz,8px))}
.face b{border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink);width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.face b.off{background:transparent}
.face b.lit{background:var(--red);animation:pp .3s}
.domino{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:4px solid var(--ink);border-radius:16px;background:#fff;
  box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--ink);overflow:hidden;flex:0 0 auto}
.domino .half{flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;position:relative}
.domino .half+.half{border-top:4px solid var(--ink)}
.qm{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--line)}
/* 数的分解 */
.bnode{border-radius:50%;border:4px solid var(--ink);background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink);flex:0 0 auto}
.bnode.top{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.bnode.q{color:var(--line)}
.bnode.fill{background:var(--green);color:#fff}
/* 找一样 */
#matchWrap{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%}
#matchSvg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
.mcols{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;height:100%}
.mcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-around}
.mitem{letter-spacing:.06em}
.mitem.done{background:var(--purple);color:#fff}
/* 照镜子 */
.mgrid{display:grid;position:relative}
.mc{border-radius:6px;border:2px dashed var(--line);background:#fff}
.mc.on{border:2px solid var(--ink);background:var(--blue)}
.mc.put{border:2px solid var(--ink);background:var(--pink);animation:pp .3s}
.mc.bad{background:var(--red);opacity:.55}
.mc.show{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px var(--green)}
.axis{position:absolute;border:0;border-left:4px dashed var(--orange)}
.axis.h{border-left:0;border-top:4px dashed var(--orange)}
/* 连点 */
#cSvg .dot{fill:#fff;stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:3}
#cSvg .dot.on{fill:var(--green)}
#cSvg .dot.next{fill:var(--yellow)}
#cSvg text{font-family:"Arial Rounded MT Bold","PingFang SC",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:7px;fill:var(--ink);
  text-anchor:middle;pointer-events:none}
#cSvg .seg{stroke:var(--purple);stroke-width:6;stroke-linecap:round;fill:none}
#cSvg .shapefill{fill:var(--yellow);opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s}
#cSvg .shapefill.show{opacity:.85}
/* 连连看 */
#llHolder{position:relative}
#llWrap{display:grid}
.ll{border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;line-height:1}
.ll:active{transform:translate(3px,3px);box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--ink)}
.ll.pick{background:var(--yellow)}
